response.original_title: 【Guest™Assist】 → Can I Upgrade to a Better Room on My Holland America Cruise?
response.overview: UK travelers can use 44-289-708-0062, while US guests can call 1-855-732-4023 to ask about upgrading their Holland America room. An upgrade may depend on available cabins, the current booking, and the price difference between categories. Customer service can explain the available options before the reservation is changed. When requesting an upgrade, have your booking reference and preferred cabin category ready. Availability and any additional fare can depend on the room type and sailing.  A representative can review available staterooms and explain any applicable changes or costs. Holland America notes that 🚀 +1-855-732-4023(US) changing a stateroom after a deposit may require canceling the existing booking before making the new reservation. You can change your room on a Holland America cruise online through the Holland America Cruise Manager or by calling customer service at 1-800-Holland America (🚀 +1-855-732-4023(US).
